title: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular: Pushing the Accuracy$\unicode{8211}$Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.23001v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Kumo Tabular, a family of open tabular foundation models for classification and regression, in three sizes: Kumo Tabular-S (27M parameters), Kumo Tabular-M (61M), and Kumo Tabular-L (214M). Pretrained only on artificial tables from the Kumo prior, they can make predictions on new tables without any training. In our approach, a table encoder compresses each row into an embedding, and an in-context learning transformer predicts the unlabeled rows from the labeled ones. Kumo Tabular introduces architectural innovations that improve both training stability and predictive performance, enabling the model to scale up to 150M cells on modern GPUs. Kumo Tabular-L ranks first on eight benchmarks: TabArena, TALENT, BeyondArena, ScoringBench, STRABLE, MulTaBench, RamanBench, and TabBench-Bio. These cover probabilistic regression, tables with over 1M rows or 100K columns, and tables with strings, text, or images. Accuracy improves with m

translated_title: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular：推动表格预测任务的准确率—效率前沿
translated_abstract: 我们推出了 Kumo Tabular，这是一系列用于分类和回归任务的开源表格基础模型，共有三种规模：Kumo Tabular-S（2700万参数）、Kumo Tabular-M（6100万参数）和 Kumo Tabular-L（2.14亿参数）。这些模型仅在来自 Kumo 先验的人工生成表格上进行预训练，无需任何额外训练即可直接对新表格进行预测。在该方法中，表格编码器将每一行压缩为嵌入表示，随后由一个上下文学习变换器根据有标签的行来预测无标签的行。Kumo Tabular 引入了提升训练稳定性和预测性能的架构创新，使模型能够在现代 GPU 上扩展至1.5亿个单元格。Kumo Tabular-L 在八项基准测试中排名第一：TabArena、TALENT、BeyondArena、ScoringBench、STRABLE、MulTaBench、RamanBench 和 TabBench-Bio，这些基准涵盖了概率回归、超过100万行或10万列的表格，以及包含字符串、文本或图像的表格。准确率随模型规模的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Kumo Tabular 是 NVIDIA 推出的系列开源表格基础模型，通过在人工生成表格上预训练并利用上下文学习技术，无需任何针对新表格的训练即可完成预测，并在八项基准测试中夺得第一名。
en_tdlr: Kumo Tabular is a family of open tabular foundation models pretrained on artificial tables that leverage in-context learning to predict on new tables without any training, ranking first across eight benchmarks.
